home-who-title: From our family to your shelves
home-who-body: Every drop of AETHERA honey comes from the unique flora of Kos, harvested with care and respect for nature. As a family operation, we insist on transparency: lab analyses, traceability and photo QC before every shipment.
home-who-body-2: We work with importers, delicatessen and HORECA across Europe, providing consistent batches and premium packaging that celebrates the Aegean aesthetic.
home-who-link: Learn more about the AETHERA family
home-products-lead: A balanced collection of single-origin honey and EVOO with a clear terroir, curated for shelves and wholesale.
home-product1-desc: Glass jars 250g / 450g / 950g, matte black & gold, ready for gourmet shelves or gifting.
home-product2-desc: Cold-pressed EVOO in dark bottles for retail and bulk tins/IBC for HORECA.
home-experience-title: Flavor that stands out at breakfast and fine dining
home-experience-body1: From a breakfast table with yogurt cream and fresh bread to a gourmet plate finished with EVOO, the AETHERA experience blends purity of taste with elegant presentation.
home-experience-body2: We curate white/black/gold styling, minimal sets, and photography you can reuse in catalogs or e-commerce.
home-cert-body: Every batch ships with analyses (HMF, diastase, moisture), photo QC, and full compliance to EU standards.
home-testimonial-1: “Consistent quality in every batch and fast responses. Packaging is already set for premium shelves.”
home-testimonial-1-meta: Maria K. — Gourmet retail buyer, Berlin
home-testimonial-2: “AETHERA EVOO added character to our olive oil list. Photos and tech sheets were professional and complete.”
home-testimonial-2-meta: Chef Andrea R. — Executive Chef, Milan
home-testimonial-3: “We receive pallets with COA, QC photos, and secure wrapping. Trust from the very first shipment.”

products-lead: Authentic thyme honey and extra virgin olive oil from Kos. Every batch comes with lab analyses, photo QC, and retail or bulk options ready for export.
products-fact1-text: Our branded jars and bottles, ready for shelves and gifting.
products-fact2-text: Honey: 20kg / 50kg / 300kg. EVOO: tins, drums, IBC on request.
products-fact3-text: Lab analyses, batch traceability, EU-compliant labels.
products-fact4-text: Palletized loads, QC photos on request, responsive support.
products-honey-desc: Every drop of AETHERA honey comes from the flora of Kefalos, Kos. Unfiltered, unblended, lab-tested and traceable.
products-honey-retail-3: Cases of 6 or 12; EN or bilingual labels
products-honey-logistics-3: Lead time: 1–3 weeks depending on labels & stock
products-olive-desc: Cold-pressed EVOO with fresh aroma, balanced bitterness, and peppery finish. Options for retail gifting and bulk for HORECA.
products-olive-retail-2: Tamper-evident caps, nitrogen flush on request
products-olive-retail-3: Cases of 6 or 12, gift box option
products-olive-logistics-3: Lead time: 1–3 weeks depending on packaging

about-lead: Export-focused Greek premium products from Kos Island: single-origin honey and extra virgin olive oil, supplied to wholesalers, distributors, and hospitality groups with lab-tested quality.
about-snapshot-3: Focus: Single-origin honey and extra virgin olive oil
about-snapshot-4: Exports: Retail jars & bulk for EU/international partners
about-production-4: Lead times: 1-3 weeks depending on labels and stock
about-quality-1: Batch traceability by harvest and apiary location
about-quality-2: Lab analyses: diastase, HMF, moisture, conductivity
about-quality-4: EU food safety and export documentation provided
about-steps-1: Raw intake: visual inspection, moisture check, lot coding
about-steps-2: Lab verification: diastase, HMF, conductivity per batch
about-steps-3: Packing: filtered for particulates, unheated to preserve enzymes
about-sustain-1: Apiaries placed among thyme and pine flora in Kos
about-sustain-2: Minimal transport; no antibiotics; careful swarm management
about-sustain-3: Respectful harvesting to maintain colony health
about-docs-1: COA and lab PDF available per shipment
about-docs-2: Traceable batch IDs and harvest season on labels
